name: Sudoku + 7 Other Complex Puzzles by Nikoli
formal_name: Sudoku + 7 Other Complex Puzzles by Nikoli
description:
Contains a total of 8 types of puzzles, including the world famous "Sudoku"!
Contains 1000 questions in 8 types!
Outstanding operability achieved through collaboration with Nicoli!
There are many elements unique to the Nintendo 3DS, such as an enlarged display of the board and 3D display of input numbers!
Furthermore, up to 4 people can compete online.
disclaimer:
The contents of the software are the same as the package version released on March 31, 2011 (price: 4,104 yen).
Due to the large amount of data, it may take a long time to download the software. Please download while charging your Nintendo 3DS.
